title: Word Break
prompt: Given a string `s` and a list of strings `word_dict`, return `True` if `s` can be segmented into a space-separated sequence of one or more dictionary words. The same word may be reused any number of times.
constraints: All words in word_dict are unique.
hints: Think of dp[i] as 'can the first i characters of s be segmented into dictionary words?'
dp[0] is True (empty prefix). For each i, check every j < i: if dp[j] is True and s[j:i] is in the word set, dp[i] is True.
Using a set for word_dict makes each substring lookup O(1) instead of scanning the whole list.
